review: Own route, planned before reading a2-a4 (same model family, older version): the twist must shift every site's embedded field sigma = n s, empty sites included; splitting each bond weight into a twisted Gaussian of strength beta' and an untwisted vacancy kernel gives Gaussian domination whenever c >= c0(beta - beta'), so <|sigma^e(k)|^2> <= 1/((beta - gamma(c)) E(k)) for every fugacity with no density dependence (the full beta for c >= 1, and for c >= c1(beta) in the two-valued menu via small twists), and long-range order once (beta - gamma(c)) rho > 3G(0); at the neutral scale the route closes, and both the full-beta bound and attempt a3's 1/(beta rho2 E(k)) are false, with exact 2x2x2 counterexamples X1 (1.47 > 1) and X2 (1.81 > 1).
what: DERIVATION, independent attempt 1 of 4: The transverse kernel and long-range order for the sphere menu with vacancies. SETTING (the owner's working reading, 2026-09-20; block 39, the open PR titled 'ail39: records that move'): a site is empty or carries ONE record; a record carries its content (six axes); two neighbouring records weigh W = c * omega, omega = p, q, r for equal, opposite, orthogonal axes; a bond with an empty end weighs 1; the axioms' rule K (normalized over contents) does not depend on the scale c. MOTION: a record chooses between its position and an empty neighbouring position in proportion to the pair weights it would have there; this is in detailed balance with the static law on the occupied set. The neutral scale c_0 = 6/(p + q + 4r): an empty neighbour weighs what a record of random content weighs on average, and it is the least scale at which the law with vacancies is reflection positive through bond planes. Simulator: probes/lib/moving_gas.py p q r scale rho L sweeps seed (scale = a number or the word neutral). Block 19 (PR #8153) proved the infrared bound and long-range order for the full-lattice static sphere law by bond-plane reflection positivity; block 39's T5 shows that with an empty state the bond kernel stays positive semidefinite exactly for c >= c_0 = beta/sinh(beta). TASK: carry block 19's argument to the law with vacancies at fugacity z: (a) Gaussian domination with the enlarged one-site space; what the twisted partition function twists (only the records); (b) the infrared bound for the transverse field of the records, s_x 1[x occupied], and the sum rule with the density rho = <1[occupied]>; (c) long-range order for beta large and rho above an explicit value, or the obstruction; (d) the stiffness: how the coefficient of 1/E(k) depends on the density and on c. Exact finite checks on small tori with a two-valued content as in block 36's runner. DELIVERABLE, in your unit worktree on ai/probes: probes/work/derive/moving-kernel-with-vacancies/<your worker name>/ATTEMPT.md and check.py. ATTEMPT.md: (1) the exact statement you attempt; (2) numbered steps, each marked PROVED (argument given in full), CHECKED (a finite fact check.py verifies exactly) or ASSUMED; (3) if the route fails, the FIRST step that fails and why: a precise no-go for a route is a result; (4) what would finish it. check.py: exact arithmetic (fractions, integers, sympy) for every finite claim; it prints `SUMMARY: PROVED ...`, `SUMMARY: COUNTEREXAMPLE ...`, `SUMMARY: PARTIAL <what is new and exact>` or `SUMMARY: ROUTE FAILS AT <step>`, and a line `HIT: <the claim>` ONLY when you claim a proof, a counterexample, or a new exact partial result others can build on; a HIT is handed to a worker of another model family to referee line by line, so write for a hostile reader. Rules: definitions come from the notes on the PR branches named above (git fetch origin <branch>; git show origin/<branch>:<note>; find them with gh pr view <n> --json files,headRefName); any outside theorem you use must be re-proved at the scope you use it or listed under ASSUMED; no status words (proved theorems are promoted by the supervisor after the referee). Have your own plan BEFORE reading the prior attempts printed at claim time; then either build on a refereed partial result or take a different route. Run: python3 probes/run_probe.py <task> --worker <name> --model <model> --review "..." --extra "python3 probes/work/derive/moving-kernel-with-vacancies/<name>/check.py"
